LanguageData.BTG_AdoptBlockedByGuardians: Their people are still protecting them.
LanguageData.BTG_Settings_EnableCargoVaultDesc:
When enabled, cargo vault hatches in shuttle bays can be hacked to access trade inventory.
When disabled, cargo vaults spawn sealed and inaccessible.
Only affects newly generated settlements, and requires the custom settlement map generator.
The smuggler's den vault is controlled by its quest reward instead of this setting.
LanguageData.BTG_Settings_TraderRotationDesc1: How often orbital traders rotate at TradersGuild settlements.
LanguageData.BTG_Settings_TraderRotationDesc2: Lower values = more variety, but less time to reach distant settlements.
LanguageData.BTG_Settings_UseCustomLayoutsDesc: Generate TradersGuild settlements with less abandoned-looking aesthetics.\nDisable if using other map generation mods or prefer vanilla layouts.\nThe smuggler's den quest site always uses its own map generator, whatever this is set to.
LanguageData.BTG_Settings_SentryDroneDesc: Factor of threat points used for additional patrolling sentry drones.\nApplies to settlements and the smuggler's den alike.
LanguageData.BTG_Settings_EntrenchedDefendersDesc:
Defenders hold their structure and never assault or chase intruders into vacuum, foraging and resting inside their base.
Disable to revert to vanilla defender AI (defends the base, then assaults).
Governs settlement garrisons (when the custom settlement map generator is on) and the smuggler's den garrison (always).
Decided when a map is generated; only affects maps entered afterwards.
LanguageData.BTG_Settings_ScaleDefenders: Scale defenders to colony threat level
LanguageData.BTG_Settings_ScaleDefendersDesc: Initial defender strength scales with your colony's wealth and difficulty, like raids do (never below the vanilla baseline).\nVanilla gives every settlement a similar fixed-strength garrison regardless of your progress.\nSettlements only: the smuggler's den garrison is sized by its quest instead.
LanguageData.BTG_Settings_ThreatMultiplierDesc: Higher values = more/stronger initial defenders when entering settlements.\nSettlements only: the smuggler's den garrison is sized by its quest instead.
LanguageData.BTG_Settings_SecurityDefeatThresholdDesc: How much of a settlement's or smugglers den's original defence force must be downed before the guild gives up the map.\nCounts defending guards and patrolling sentry drones, not turrets or worker mechs.\n100% means fighting to the last defender.
LanguageData.BTG_Settings_LifeSupportDesc: Power output from orbital LifeSupportUnits.\nChanges the building type itself, so it affects every orbital platform on the planet, not only Traders Guild maps.
LanguageData.BTG_Settings_TradeRequestQuestWeightDesc: How often the storyteller offers the guild's shuttle trade request quest, weighed against every other quest it could pick.\nSet to 0 to stop the quest being offered at all.
LanguageData.BTG_Settings_SmugglersDenQuestWeightDesc: How often the storyteller offers the smuggler's den quest, weighed against every other quest it could pick.\nSet to 0 to stop the quest being offered at all.
LanguageData.BTG_ResupplyDropArrived: The garrison's distress call has drawn a response.
LanguageData.BTG_Settings_ResupplyMealsPerDefenderDes: When starving defenders have exhausted all food inside the structure, they use a comms console to call in a survival-meal cargo pod: this many meals per surviving defender.\nSet to 0 to disable resupply calls entirely. At most one drop lands per map every 6 hours.\nRequires entrenched defender AI. Applies to settlements and the smuggler's den alike.
LanguageData.BTG_Settings_ResupplyTriggersRaidDesc: When a resupply call succeeds, also summon a drop-pod raid of the garrison faction's reinforcements to hunt your pawns. They arrive as a normal raid rather than as bounded defenders. Small chance they drop right on top of your pawns in a smaller group. Only fires while the map's faction is hostile.
LanguageData.BTG_CargoVaultHatch_RelockDesc: Relock the cargo vault. Contents will be returned to station inventory.
LanguageData.BTG_EmpireRelationFix_DialogBody:
A bug in a previous version of {2} caused {0} to be permanently hostile when playing as {1}.

This has been corrected.

Would you like to reset your relations with {0} to neutral, or remain hostile for now?
LanguageData.BTG_GameStartDialog_ExiledTraders:
Your guild transponder is dead, and the mechhive tracks your signal. Its terrifying murder machines will arrive soon. Gather the valuable gravlite panels, then use your gravship to flee to a safe location on the planet below.

To launch the gravship, select the pilot console, then select the launch command.

On the world map, select 'view planet' to choose a landing spot on the planet.

The Guild won't help you, and wherever you go, the mechanoids will eventually find you. To stop them, you must find and defeat the mechhive itself.
LanguageData.BTG_GameStartDialog_IndependentTraders: The trade frequency chirps its farewell as your shuttle clears the orbital ring. Years of guild runs, split margins, and crowded docking bays - all behind you. No hard feelings. Just bigger plans.\n\nYour shuttle burns toward unclaimed wilds, yet silver alone won't keep you alive out here. The guild will still deal with old friends - but first, you need a home.
